description: The file defines the SimpleMapProcess class, which manages a sequence of string operations for processing a specific field in a map, such as validation, comparison, copying, conversion, and regexp matching. It reads operation configurations from XML elements and applies them during execution.

classes.name: SimpleMapProcess
classes.description: Manages a sequence of string operations for a specific field, reading configuration from XML and executing them on input maps.

methods.name: SimpleMapProcess
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the process with configuration from an XML element.

methods.name: exec
methods.description: Executes all contained string operations on the input map, accumulating results, messages, and considering locale and class loader.

methods.name: getFieldName
methods.description: Returns the name of the field this process operates on.

methods.name: readOperations
methods.description: Parses child XML elements to instantiate and add corresponding operation objects to the process.
